messages:
Mira (Product): Hey team — quick sync: we're building the new runtime dashboard and need to lock down RBAC + sharing policy for internal vs customer-facing views. Need infra/telemetry inputs and audit requirements. Thoughts? :wave:
Alex (Eng-Platform): +1. Can we list the actual metrics we need from runtime/infra first? I'll map to storage/labels.
Priya (Security): From security/compliance side: we need an access audit trail (who viewed/shared/exported), retention policy, and field-level masking for customer views. Also will need export controls (:lock:).
Linh (Console UX): UX question — how do we intend to share? team links, org-wide dashboards, or per-customer share links with expiry? Each has different perms.
Jorge (SRE): For telemetry, add stable labels: model_variant, route_policy, region, capacity_tier, node_pool, gpu_type. Also prefix/cache hit rate, batching stats, tokens_per_request, p50/p95 latency. We should avoid free-text tags.
Alex (Eng-Platform): Runtime metric list proposal: ["p50_latency_ms","p95_latency_ms","tokens_consumed","batch_size_avg","cache_hit_rate","model_variant","route_policy","requests_per_min"]. From infra: ["node_pool","gpu_type","instance_uptime","available_capacity"]. Will add label schema.
Mira (Product): Good. Also need to surface quota usage per-token and per-route in the same dashboard for SLO ops.
Priya (Security): Audit log schema: {user_id, display_name, action, object_type, object_id, view_mode(internal/customer), filters, timestamp, ip}. Retention: default 365 days for enterprise, 90 for self-serve. Need downloadable tamper-evident export for compliance.
Sam (Legal): Confirming: retention 365 days ok for enterprise customers; for regulated customers we may need custom retention—add support for configurable retention windows. Also we need proof of access (who accessed which customer-facing view) for audits.
Linh (Console UX): On masking — for customer-facing views we should default to field-level obfuscation for telemetry with PII (user ids, IPs) and provide a toggle for customers to opt into more detailed views with an MSA. UX will show "masked" with hover to request access.
Alex (Eng-Platform): RBAC roles draft: ["viewer","editor","owner","admin","customer_viewer"]. Mapping rules: customer_viewer => sanitized fields + no raw traces, internal viewer => full metrics, editor => can create/edit dashboards, owner => can share and set retention.
Jorge (SRE): Instrumentation note: Prometheus metrics ok for aggregates; wire trace links to tracing backend (trace_id in table) but for customer_viewer we must hash trace_ids and remove IPs. Sampling rules: keep full traces for internal only, sampled for customer views.
Mira (Product): Ok. We also need sharing primitives: share-to-team (team id), share-to-org (org id), share-public-link (expiring + tokenized), and share-to-customer (org-specific masked). Controls must be in the share modal.
Priya (Security): Add policy enforcement points: when a share is created, check policy: if share_to_customer => apply masking and log event. If share_public_link => default expiry 7d, must require owner permission.
Alex (Eng-Platform): Example policy snippet (draft):
```
rbac_roles:
  - name: customer_viewer
    allowed_actions: [read_metrics]
    field_filters: {mask: ["ip","user_id"], redact: ["trace_payload"]}
    retention_limits: {audit_logs_days: 90}
```
That will go into platform-auth service.
Linh (Console UX): For the share modal, I'll mock flows: choose view (internal/customer), pick role (viewer/editor), choose recipients (team/org/email), optional expiry, and checkboxes for export allowed.
Mira (Product): Do we need per-dashboard audit-visible diffs (who changed what) or just access logs?
Priya (Security): Diffs are helpful for admin audits. We should store change_events: {who, what_changed, before, after, timestamp}. Keep for enterprise 365d.
Jorge (SRE): Storage caution: high-cardinality labels in metrics blow up TSDB. Recommend we keep labels limited to: model_variant, route_policy, region, capacity_tier. Others go into logs (Elasticsearch) for ad-hoc queries.
Alex (Eng-Platform): Good call. We'll push heavy metadata to logs/GRPC events and keep cardinality-safe labels in Prom. Also add an indexed "dashboard_id" label to link metrics -> dashboard.
Sam (Legal): One more: exports of dashboards or CSVs that contain masked fields must include a compliance banner and export reason logged.
Mira (Product): Action items: Alex to produce final metric + label schema, Jorge to propose sampling/storage plan, Priya to define audit schema and retention, Linh to wire share modal mockups, Sam to confirm legal banner language. Can we aim for EOW? :calendar:  
Alex (Eng-Platform): I'll have the schema PR by Thu.
Jorge (SRE): Will post sampling plan and TSDB note by Wed.
Priya (Security): Draft audit schema and retention options by Fri.
Linh (Console UX): Mockups in Figma by Fri EOD.
Sam (Legal): I'll send the compliance blurb tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy 1765 deployed to staging (dashboards/rbac) :rocket:
Mira (Product): Thanks everyone — we'll review in sync on Monday. :thumbsup:
